path: Sensors and Switches/Sensors and Switches - Cooling System/Engine - Coolant Temperature Sensor/Switch/Service and Repair/ECT Sensor 1 Replacement
title: ECT Sensor 1 Replacement
text:
ECT Sensor 1 Replacement
ECT Sensor 1 Replacement
1. Drain the engine coolant Service and Repair.
2. Disconnect the ECT sensor 1 connector (A).
3. Remove ECT sensor 1 (B).
4. Install the parts in the reverse order of removal with a new O-ring (C), then refill the radiator with engine coolant Service and Repair.
<div class="

path: Sensors and Switches/Sensors and Switches - Cooling System/Engine - Coolant Temperature Sensor/Switch/Service and Repair/ECT Sensor 2 Replacement
title: ECT Sensor 2 Replacement
text:
ECT Sensor 2 Replacement
ECT Sensor 2 Replacement
1. Remove the front splash shield. Front Splash Shield Replacement
2. Drain the engine coolant Service and Repair.
3. Disconnect the ECT sensor 2 connector (A), then remove ECT sensor 2 (B).
4. Install ECT sensor 2 with a new O-ring (C).
5. Install the front splash shield. Front Splash Shield Replacement
6. Refill the radiator with engine coolant Service and Repair.
